name: PoolPartyBof
help: Inject shellcode by abusing Windows Thread Pools
long_help: Sliver extension bundles variant 8 only (TP_TIMER). Use the Cobalt Strike CNA or Havoc script for variants 4-8.

arguments.name: delay
arguments.desc: Seconds to wait between major API steps (0 = none)

arguments.name: drip
arguments.desc: 1 = page-sized drip alloc/write of shellcode, 0 = one-shot (default)

arguments.name: drip_ms
arguments.desc: Milliseconds to wait between drip pages (0 = none, capped at 1000). Requires drip=1
